errors.evidence: The x-axis categories are "Support of Authorities", "Extended Contact", and "Virtual Contact". This is not an alphabetical ordering.

errors.text_span: the stacked “No Contact After” bar extends to 0.04%
errors.evidence: This phrasing is confusing and incorrectly describes how a stacked bar chart works. The "No Contact After" bar segment has a value/height of 0.04%; it does not "extend to" 0.04% on the y-axis. The total height of that stacked bar is 39.50 + 0.04 = 39.54%.

errors.text_span: from 31.83% for “Negative Contact Before” in “Support of Authorities”
errors.evidence: The bar with a value of 31.83% corresponds to “Positive Contact Before” in the “Support of Authorities” category, not “Negative Contact Before”.

errors.text_span: to 47.28% for “Negative Contact Before” in “Virtual Contact”
errors.evidence: The bar with a value of 47.28% is in the “Extended Contact” category, not the “Virtual Contact” category.
The description claims there are no annotations, but the chart clearly displays numerical value annotations for every single bar segment.
